Ava (Hiring Ops): @here Quick heads-up — Elena Ramos (starts Mon) ran into two issues: passport expiring in 2 months and her background check tool returned a name-format mismatch (maiden vs current). Need to lock down I-9 plan + laptop courier. :wave:
Maya (People Ops): OK. For I-9, remote hires in her state can do a virtual I-9 with approved notary or drop-in kiosk. Does Elena have a stateside ID?
Elena Ramos (new hire): Hi! I only have a passport (expiring), and a driver's license under my maiden name. I uploaded both to the background portal — the mismatch note shows maiden vs married. Will a notarized passport copy work?
Ava (Hiring Ops): Thanks. @Sana can you confirm whether we can accept notarized passport + DL (name mismatch) for background and I-9? If not, we'll schedule a 1:1 kiosk visit Monday.
Sana (Security): For I-9, USCIS rules are strict: we need acceptable docs with matching names OR an attached legal name-change doc (marriage cert). For background checks, identity can be verified with additional docs but the match needs human review. If Elena can provide marriage certificate (scan), that would resolve both.
Elena Ramos (new hire): I can upload a scanned marriage certificate tonight. If not, how urgent is the kiosk? I'm in NYC and can do a quick in-person slot Monday morning.
Jonah (IT): Re laptop: I can ship a laptop overnight but need exact shipping address and preferred courier. If she visits the kiosk Monday AM we could do same-day pickup at office. Which do you prefer?
Ava (Hiring Ops): Elena — what's easier: courier or office pickup? If courier, Jonah pls create a temporary laptop image and limit admin creds until security clears.
Elena Ramos (new hire): Courier is better for me. I won't be at the office Mon.
Jonah (IT): Cool. I'll prepare a laptop with the standard onboarding image (no admin). ETA DHL next-business-day if label is generated today.
Jonah (IT): Shipping snippet I used:```ship_label --to "Elena Ramos" --addr "Apt 8, 45 W 23rd St, New York, NY 10010" --service DHL --signature required```
Maya (People Ops): I'll set up a temporary badge QR via BadgeBot so Elena can access the building for any future visits. @BadgeBot can you create a 72-hour guest pass tied to her email?
BadgeBot: Guest pass created for elena.ramos@redwood.com — expires in 72h — QR sent via email. :white_check_mark:
Sana (Security): One more security step: we lock down VPN until background + I-9 docs are cleared. Jonah — please withhold VPN group membership and admin privileges until clearance flag is set.
Jonah (IT): Roger. I'll hold VPN and admin until People Ops marks "cleared" in the onboarding tracker.
Ethan (People Ops): Day-1 schedule (adjusted): 9:00am PT welcome sync (Zoom), 9:30 benefits overview, 10:00 IT drop-in for laptop provisioning Qs, 11:00 hiring manager intro. Elena — can you make 9am PT?
Elena Ramos (new hire): 9am PT works. Thanks everyone — uploading marriage cert now.
Ava (Hiring Ops): Perfect. Action items: Elena uploads marriage cert (DONE = fastest), Jonah ships laptop with limited access, Sana to confirm clearance rules after doc review, Maya to add temporary badge and calendar invites for Day-1 sessions. I'll update the tracker and ping again once background is re-run. :thumbsup:
